interface.title: GC–EI–MS Annotation Tool (v2.1.0)
interface.field: Analytical chemistry: gas-chromatography electron-ionization mass spectrometry (GC–EI–MS), compound annotation / metabolomics / essential-oil profiling
interface.stage_of_work: Data analysis and interpretation: tentative identification of measured spectra against a reference library, then reporting
interface.what_it_is_for: Rank the 10 closest library compounds for one or many EI mass spectra (mz, intensity peak lists), score how far the top hit can be trusted (spectral similarity, top-two margin, ML library-label agreement score), flag hits under a Standard or Strict screening rule, and export the results as CSV.

data.note: Single spectrum: I pasted the 4-peak template (41,82.1 / 43,44.6 / 69,71.5 / 93,100) into the text area, then uploaded template_single_spectrum.csv (62 B; its peaks differ from the 44-B template the app downloads, so the scores differ). Batch: I uploaded example_batch_12_botanical.csv (12 spectra, IDs such as CdeL_P02, Jde_P13, Fde_P05). The first Analyze click took a few minutes while the 8,455-entry reference library was built; later runs were fast.

tree.general: Tentatively identify unknown compounds from their measured spectra by library matching, judge how far each match can be trusted, and record the results
tree.specific: Annotate GC–EI–MS spectra against the 8,455-identity MS-DIAL-derived library, screen the top hits with the Standard or Strict rule, and download the CSV summaries

features.name: Provenance-stamped CSV report export
features.general: Export results together with the software version and checksums of the reference data and model, so the analysis can be audited and reproduced
features.specific: Download result summary and Download batch results write CSVs that carry software_version, reference_connectivity_count, the reference index, HGB model and source MSP SHA-256 hashes, screening_setting, screening_criterion_met and flags such as chemical_identity_independently_confirmed=False. Download candidate table writes only rank, connectivity_id, inchi_key, smiles and similarity, with no version or hashes
